{"path": "$LABHOME/apx/runs/q27m-pr-v4/home/.openclaw/workspace/make_label.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a printable lab label for a copper sample."""
import datetime, os
from fpdf import FPDF

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "copper_sample_label.pdf")

# --- Sample metadata (edit these fields per sample) ---
SAMPLE_NAME   = "Copper"
ELEMENT       = "Cu"
ATOMIC_NO     = "29"
FORM          = "Metallic solid"
CAS           = "7440-50-8"
PREPARED_BY   = "Lab Assistant"
DATE          = datetime.date.today().isoformat()

# --- Layout: A4 portrait, one label per page (print & cut) ---
pdf = FPDF(orientation="P", unit="mm", format="a4")
pdf.add_page()

# Label box
LX, LY, LW, LH = 20, 30, 160, 90
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 28)
pdf.cell(LW, 15, SAMPLE_NAME.upper(), align="C")

pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 13)
lines = [
    f"Element: {ELEMENT}   Atomic No.: {ATOMIC_NO}",
    f"Form: {FORM}",
    f"CAS: {CAS}",
    f"Prepared by: {PREPARED_BY}",
    f"Date: {DATE}",
]
for ln in lines:
    pdf.cell(LW, 9, ln, align="C")

# Border around the label
pdf.set_draw_color(0)
pdf.set_line_width(0.6)
pdf.rect(LX, LY, LW, LH)

pdf.output(OUT)
print("wrote", OUT)
"}
